You gotta be kidding me—0 HOT setups across 0 tickers?! This is the market waving a giant red flag. It's not just that the squeeze board is empty. It’s the fact that we’re tracking nothing, nada, zilch. That kind of silence is deafening, and it tells you one thing loud and clear: the market is in full-on chop mode. Everyone’s indecisive. Bulls don’t want to commit; bears are licking wounds from the relentless grind higher this year. The question now isn’t about sector rotations or new leadership—it’s about surviving.

Risk is neutral, but let’s be honest, that feels like an understatement. When the board goes blank like this, it’s not a time to hero-trade. **The market is telling us something. Are we listening? Neutral means you either take a beat or play small ball until the big moves start flowing again.** The squeeze data isn’t just an indicator; it’s your cheat code for understanding sentiment. No HOT tickers means no clear directional edge, and WARM setups? No dice there either.

But let’s talk portfolio because, hey, we don’t sit on our hands here. Take positions like $COIN, $UUUU, $MP, and $BTU—they’re well ahead, sold 50%, and sitting pretty for anyone who followed the game plan. These names stand out as the only things catching a bid in an otherwise sleepy tape. Crypto continues to hold up—$ETHA, $BMNR, $COIN are still printing green candles. That’s leadership. Energy-related plays like $OXY, $APA, and materials names like $MP and $UAMY are still showing resilience, too. If you missed the early entries, know that late dips might be where the next easy money is. But don’t rush; the market needs to prove it’s ready to actually break somewhere first.

What’s not working? $HIMS, $QBTS, and its fellow laggards. These pieces of junk have gone nowhere but sideways since entry and are now dead weight in the portfolio. They’re reminders that holding trash is fine when there’s momentum behind it, but without it? You’re just wasting time and mental energy. Don’t marry your positions—the second these things can’t fly, you’ve got my permission to kick them to the curb.

Here’s your focus today: Is the chop gonna break, and if so, where? The big three are still the same: energy, crypto, and rare earths. That’s your map to the few places that might give late-week entries if they show life around resistance. Earnings season is over so don’t expect some headline roller coaster to bail us out here. Watch for buyers stepping in anywhere unusual because they’re the ones who tell you where the next big money move is coming. If the squeeze board stays dead tomorrow too? Bears might finally have something to smile about. Until then, stay nimble.
